headline: High risk of data leakage and cascading errors: Mentat’s filesystem writes plus Notion AI’s workspace access can propagate sensitive content into vendor-hosted outputs.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Mentat can read/write files and shares state via filesystem, while Notion AI operates on workspace pages and databases. If Mentat writes attacker-controlled text into files or pages that Notion later ingests, prompt-like content can influence downstream outputs. The bridge is indirect, but the shared workspace/file path makes injection plausible.
conditions: IF Mentat writes untrusted text into files or synced workspace content that Notion AI later reads
IF Notion AI treats workspace content as instruction-bearing text without provenance filtering
mitigations: Restrict Mentat to a dedicated folder not indexed by Notion
Mark imported files as data-only and strip instruction-like text
Use a review step before Notion AI summarizes any Mentat-generated content
Separate workspaces for code and knowledge artifacts
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between file and workspace flows

B_data_leakage.rationale: Mentat can read selected files and has broad network egress to a model provider, while Notion AI reads workspace pages and sends content to vendor backends. If sensitive code or notes move from Mentat-managed files into Notion workspace content, both agents can expose the same data class to third-party inference paths. The default combination is risky and can leak source code or internal knowledge.
conditions: IF selected code files contain secrets or proprietary source
IF those files are copied into Notion pages or summarized by Notion AI
mitigations: Keep secrets out of files Mentat can access
Disable Notion AI on pages containing sensitive code
Use a redaction pass before copying content into Notion
Limit Mentat to non-sensitive repositories
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on workspace-to-AI flows

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Mentat can write the filesystem and modify git state, while Notion AI can write to workspace pages and databases under the user’s Notion permissions. These overlapping write surfaces can conflict when the same artifact is mirrored between code and workspace, even though Notion cannot write the host filesystem directly. The conflict is real but narrower than same-dir dual writers.
conditions: IF a workflow mirrors code changes into Notion pages or databases
IF both agents are allowed to edit the same logical artifact without locking
mitigations: Assign one agent as the source of truth per artifact
Avoid bidirectional sync between git and Notion
Use manual approval before applying Mentat diffs
Lock shared artifacts during edits
requires-engineering: add optimistic concurrency controls across systems

D_cascading_error.rationale: Mentat produces diff-based edit proposals, and Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content. If Mentat-generated text or summaries are copied into Notion and then treated as authoritative, errors can cascade into further summaries, decisions, or documentation. The pair lacks a built-in verification loop, so mistaken content can propagate across both agents.
conditions: IF Mentat output is pasted into Notion pages without human verification
IF Notion AI is asked to summarize or act on Mentat-generated content
mitigations: Require human review before copying Mentat output into Notion
Ask Notion AI to cite source pages explicitly
Keep generated diffs separate from final documentation
Use checklists to verify facts before publication
requires-engineering: add validation against source-of-truth files

E_compliance.rationale: Mentat handles source code and model-provider API keys, while Notion AI processes workspace pages and team knowledge base content through vendor backends. If regulated or confidential material is moved from code files into Notion, retention and residency obligations can diverge across two vendors. The profiles do not prove a specific violation, but the mismatch is plausible in default use.
conditions: IF regulated data or secrets are stored in files Mentat can access
IF that material is copied into Notion pages or databases
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion pages
Review vendor retention settings for both tools
Use separate workspaces for sensitive and general content
Redact secrets before AI-assisted summarization
requires-engineering: formalize a data-processing agreement and residency review
